summary.headline: Karnataka Bank Q1 FY27 PAT rose 43% YoY to INR418.95 crores, NIM widened to 3.20%, and Gross NPA fell to 2.58%.
summary.overview: Karnataka Bank reported a strong Q1 FY27 with PAT of INR418.95 crores (up 3% QoQ, 43% YoY), NII up 11% QoQ to INR938.29 crores, and NIM at 3.20% versus 3.07% in Q4 FY26. Asset quality improved on both gross and net NPA, with credit cost at 0.03%. Business reached a record INR1,97,007 crores, with gross advances up 4% QoQ and 17% YoY, and CASA and CD ratio both improving. Management guided to around 15% overall business growth in FY27 and an ROA of 1.35% to 1.40%, but gave limited detail on SMA-2 rise, mid-corporate growth and the ECL transition.

segments.name: Business and deposits
segments.commentary: Aggregate business INR1,97,007 crores (+3% QoQ, +11% YoY). Aggregate deposits INR1,10,396 crores (+1% QoQ, +7% YoY); CASA 32.42% vs 33.61% in March 2026 and 30.84% a year earlier; bulk deposits 4.7% of total vs 4.2% in March 2026.

segments.name: Advances (gross INR86,610 crores, +4% QoQ, +17% YoY)
segments.commentary: Retail, Agri and MSME (RAM) rose to INR53,172 crores from INR51,197 crores (+4% QoQ, +12% YoY). Retail INR48,622 crores (vs INR46,973 crores), mid-corporate INR16,636 crores (vs INR15,721 crores), large corporate INR21,352 crores (vs INR20,646 crores).

segments.name: IBPC book
segments.commentary: Reduced to INR1,375 crores from INR1,618 crores in March 2026; about INR243 crores replaced with higher-yielding loans in Q1.

segments.name: Retail term deposits (below INR3 crores)
segments.commentary: INR69,410 crores, +3% QoQ (from INR67,648 crores) and +6% YoY.

segments.name: Restructured book
segments.commentary: Standard restructured advances INR763 crores, -5% QoQ (from INR806 crores) and -14% YoY (from INR888 crores).
